  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Organisation" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_INQ" name="INQ">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>START</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TRANSMIT_REQUEST</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_IP" name="IP">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CHECK_REQUEST</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>OUTCOME</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TRANSMIT_DATA</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>REJECT_REQUEST</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END_DATA</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END_REJECTED</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="START" name="Transaction data request received" />
    <bpmn:task id="TRANSMIT_REQUEST" name="Transmit the transaction data request" />
    <bpmn:task id="CHECK_REQUEST" name="Check the request of the INQ" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="OUTCOME" name="Outcome of the examination?" />
    <bpmn:task id="TRANSMIT_DATA" name="Transmit the data" />
    <bpmn:task id="REJECT_REQUEST" name="Reject the request" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END_DATA" name="Question answered with data" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END_REJECTED" name="Question answered with rejection" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="START" targetRef="TRANSMIT_REQUEST" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="TRANSMIT_REQUEST" targetRef="CHECK_REQUEST" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="CHECK_REQUEST" targetRef="OUTCOME" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" name="accepted" sourceRef="OUTCOME" targetRef="TRANSMIT_DATA" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" name="rejected" sourceRef="OUTCOME" targetRef="REJECT_REQUEST" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="TRANSMIT_DATA" targetRef="END_DATA" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="REJECT_REQUEST" targetRef="END_REJECTED" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
